sentences.text: Researchers employed an animal model of transgenic mice to evaluate a new automated technique for detecting eye blink reflexes, observing that three wild-type mice exhibited little to no blinking under identical blue light stimulation.
Using computer vision software to track six movement features and apply automated algorithms, the detection system achieved very high accuracy rates across various validation methods.
The authors conclude that this approach provides more precise timing and automated analysis than traditional air puff tests, though the study was limited to an animal model.
